responsibility: Autogenerated option-to-manual index data for the PA HP-UX-specific option table. It maps options declared in `pa-hpux.opt` such as `msio`, `nolibdld`, and `rdynamic` to the corresponding GCC manual URL suffixes, so generated option help and documentation tooling can attach the right HPPA or linker manual references without affecting target semantics or code generation.
